f51d32a1d148.en: I-Cost started in 2015 as MC Commercial Solutions, a commercial and quantity surveying business set up by Kevin Chinniah. Working on the commercial side of construction jobs, we kept seeing the same thing: the estimate in a spreadsheet, supplier quotes in email, orders in Word, and the real margin unknown until the final account.

448c9983d60c.en: In 2020 the company became I-COST LTD to build the answer: one system where the whole job lives, made for small and mid-sized UK contractors, not just the big firms. Today a small team at the University of Hertfordshire Enterprise Hub in Hatfield brings together quantity surveying, construction law, software engineering and carbon and climate expertise.

20e98d3e0c87.en: I-Cost is construction estimating, procurement, cost control and carbon software for UK contractors. The client's BOQ, your estimate, supplier quotes, purchase orders, site hours, programme and reports sit in one place, so you can see the forecast margin on every project.

0d94357dfe23.en: UK main contractors and specialist subcontractors: commercial directors, quantity surveyors, estimators, buyers, project and site managers, sustainability leads and finance teams. Suppliers use the supplier portal free of charge.

979387dac6d1.en: Can I import my client's Excel BOQ?

d6328e42ecf6.en: Yes. Upload the Excel or CSV bill of quantities, tell I-Cost what each column is, check the preview and the total, and bring the lines straight into your estimate. Nobody has to retype it.

7888b16b9551.en: Can I import a BIM model?

59ab3397363e.en: Yes. Choose an IFC file exported from Revit, ArchiCAD, Tekla or a similar program. I-Cost adds up the quantities in your browser and shows them in the same preview as a BOQ import. The model itself is not uploaded to our server. Working in Revit 2023 to 2027? The free <1>I-Cost Model Link</1> add-in sends the quantities straight from Revit, with no IFC export.

4b0bb0a91be5.en: Can't I just ask an AI chatbot for prices?

5d677f55187f.en: A chatbot on its own does not know what you pay, and material prices move every month; research has found AI estimates unreliable until they are given real rates. I-Cost keeps your supplier quotes and purchase order prices in one place, and its AI guide prices start from those: your own earlier prices for similar lines, then your own suppliers' websites if you tick it. Each guide shows its range and where it came from, project names, clients and people are never sent, and nothing goes into the estimate until you press Use. Companies get a monthly AI allowance.

1d308ac9eb30.en: Does I-Cost work out embodied carbon?

1c236ff31c4f.en: Yes. Each estimate line is matched to a material in I-Cost's carbon library, built from UK Government and ÖKOBAUDAT data, or you use your own EPD figures. Where a description is unclear, AI picks the closest material from that library; it never makes up a carbon figure, and every match shows its source. Whole life carbon assessments (beta) cover life-cycle stages A1 to A5 through to D, following the RICS Professional Standard (2nd edition) and BS EN 15978.

5a13e605c1f4.en: Can I use I-Cost on my phone?

0b191207c666.en: Yes. I-Cost runs in the browser and installs like an app on phone, tablet and PC, with no app store. Site teams log their hours from their phone with a Log my hours shortcut.

7721407b3e47.en: Yes. The live <1>Xero connection</1> sends supplier invoices to Xero as draft bills and brings paid dates back, for £10 a month for your whole company; ask for it from inside I-Cost. Or download a file for Xero's bill import, free. QuickBooks and Sage aren't supported yet.

34a653a47eef.en: No. Suppliers get a free portal where they receive your quotation requests, send prices and follow your orders.

13c43c11bfd4.en: Is our data secure? Is I-Cost ISO 27001 certified?

4b7bcefa97c9.en: Each company's data is kept separate and its files are private. Sign-in can use two-step login, and a security log shows your admins who signed in and what changed. Your data is backed up off-site every hour, with a UK standby server ready to take over. I-Cost is Cyber Essentials certified (November 2026), the UK government-backed security scheme. We are also aligning our information security with ISO/IEC 27001, the international standard; we are not certified. <1>Security & trust</1>

I-Cost does not replace drawing management, RFI or snagging tools.

a86b2a4abc74.en: Yes. You pay £35 per user per month with no set-up fee, so a team of two costs £70 a month, and you can start with a 7-day free trial on one live project. Suppliers use the portal free.
